messages:
Elaine (Sales): quick help pls — ParentCo submitted PO PC-6789 for a Dedicated POC. they want split billing between ParentCo and their UK sub and attached DPA + some MSA redlines. link: https://parentco.example.com/pc-6789

Elaine (Sales): top customer asks: split invoicing, net-60 on infra, net-30 for onboarding if possible, wet-ink on addendum (they insisted), BYOK KMS proof, and a 30-day termination-for-convenience clause in MSA redline. uploaded redlines pdf.

Mike (Legal): can you drop the redline file here? need to see indemnity expansion and the termination language.

Elaine (Sales): uploaded redlines_pc-6789.pdf. summary: they added 60-day cure, carveout for gov subpoenas, expanded indemnity to cover subcontractors, and added termination for convenience with pro-rata refund.

Jules (SE): POC details: Redwood Dedicated, reserved 200 hours, BYOK via AWS KMS. note: BYOK onboarding takes a few days and we may charge an onboarding provisioning fee.

Jules (SE): proposed order form snippet:
```
product: Redwood Dedicated
reserved_hours: 200
onboarding_fee_usd: 6000
billing: split_invoices_allowed: true
kms: customer_managed: true
```

Tanya (Finance): split invoices are workable but finance must confirm entity mapping and net terms. default net-30; net-60 requires signoff from FP&A lead. need billing emails and VAT/W-9 as applicable.

Elaine (Sales): billing contacts: accounts@parentco.com for ParentCo, uk-ap@parentco.co.uk for UK sub. they want onboarding invoiced to ParentCo and monthly infra to UK sub. current PO not line-split.

Mike (Legal): wet-ink ask: push electronic signatures. propose adding clause saying 'electronic signatures, including DocuSign, are binding'. i can draft that. on indemnity, we should narrow the scope and remove subcontractor expansion. SCCs for transfers look OK; customer requested UK mechanism.

Sam (CS): customer compliance requests SOC 2 evidence and 3 months of audit log sampling for the POC. they want an export to review.

Mike (Legal): SOC2 evidence is fine; need eng-infra check on sharing audit exports and retention. also will add EU/UK SCC references in DPA.

Jules (SE): we can provide an s3 audit export with restricted IAM role for the POC. BYOK via AWS KMS supported — onboarding ticket required.

Tanya (Finance): if onboarding_fee_usd is charged up front, PO must reference onboarding line separately. Elaine pls confirm we'll get a PO line for onboarding.

Elaine (Sales): they can split PO lines: line 1 onboarding fee to ParentCo, line 2 monthly infra to UK sub. i'll request updated PO and VAT cert.

Elaine (Sales): @Mike can you draft the MSA language for e-signature and post a redline to share with the customer? want to avoid wet-ink escalation.

Mike (Legal): yes — i'll post a tracked MSA redline and push back on indemnity/subcontractor clause. target ETA 2pm PT.

DocuSign Bot: New envelope created for MSA v2 (envelope id: 0a1b2c). status: draft.

Elaine (Sales): customer also asked for UK transfer mechanism — they prefer SCCs. @Mike please call out SCCs and locations in the DPA.

Mike (Legal): will include SCCs and annotate data residency fields. security team, pls confirm data flow.

Sam (CS): BYOK note — share key fingerprint only; confirm KMS provider (they said AWS KMS). we'll need to review key policy.

Jules (SE): AWS KMS supported. i'll open onboarding ticket INF-4521 and tag eng-infra. expect ~3 business days.

Tanya (Finance): finance will prepare two invoice templates: onboarding invoice (ParentCo) and monthly infra invoice (UK sub). prefer net-30, but can accept net-60 only with CFO approval. Elaine push customer on net-30 for onboarding.

Elaine (Sales): pinged procurement on portal — asked if onboarding can be net-30.

Procurement (external): we can accept net-30 for onboarding; monthly infra payments must remain net-60 due to internal policy.

Mike (Legal): net-60 on monthly infra ok from legal perspective but finance needs to approve operationally. ensure PO references both billing entities and includes PC-6789 on invoices.

Tanya (Finance): escalate to sales leadership if net-60 must be accepted. also need VAT registration for UK sub to create billing account.

Elaine (Sales): customer will send updated PO and VAT cert by EOD. i'll update when received.

Sam (CS): they also asked for SLA wording on latency for dedicated. our standard SLA covers uptime; per-tenant latency SLO is an enterprise add-on — for POC we can offer best-effort monitoring and dashboard visibility, not contractual latency.

Jules (SE): for contractual latency we'd need eng signoff and SLA addendum. otherwise provide monitoring and best-effort commitments during POC.

Elaine (Sales): plan of action: 1) Mike drafts e-signature + DPA/SCC changes; 2) Jules opens BYOK onboarding + INF-4521; 3) Tanya readies invoice templates and awaits VAT/W-9; 4) Elaine obtains updated PO with split lines. reconvene after Mike posts redline.

Mike (Legal): posted tracked redline -> https://redwood-internal.example/legal/redlines/pc-6789-msaredline

Elaine (Sales): received, sending to customer now. keeping this thread open for quick clarifications. :thumbsup: 

Jules (SE): opened INF-4521 for BYOK onboarding and tagged eng-infra.

Tanya (Finance): will hold creating billing accounts until updated PO & VAT are received.

Elaine (Sales): final note: customer requires PO reference PC-6789 on every invoice. pls ensure invoice templates include PO field.

Sam (CS): will include PO field in audit export metadata.

Elaine (Sales): thanks everyone — i'll update when the PO and VAT arrive.
